intro.text: An officer of the Tower who once taught Kenton to use a sword.

items.text: When Kenton's group came looking for the missing Lord General, Gremt met them and grudgingly helped Ais search the Tower for clues.

appearance.text: Of average height, with black hair and a black goatee. He wears the Tower's uniform of light blue shirt with gold trim, loose blue trousers, brown belt, tall brown boots and white cape, and carries a spear.
